senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אִסָּר, אֱסָר) prop. band, hence vow of abstinence, (cmp. איסור).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:1:5">Y. Ned. I, beg. 36ᶜ</cite>.—Pl. <he>אִיסָּרוֹת</he>, <he>אִיסָּרִין</he>, <he>אֱסָרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ibid.</cite> <he>אין לוקין על הא׳</he> the punishment of lashes is not applied for breaking vows.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 13:2:9">Y. Yeb. XIII, 13ᵈ</cite> <he>אסורות</he> (corr. acc.).
Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ top. [אֵיסָר prisoner, v. אֵיסוּר.] [Gen. R. s. 42 א׳ לשם אלסר bands (chains) forged for Elasar, v. preced.]
